OFFICE MANAGER
Crossbay Pty Ltd T/A Drive Ready Australia
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Salary: $79,423 plus Superannuation 
About Us
Drive Ready Australia is a growing vehicle rental and automotive services company based in Perth. We manage a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and are committed to delivering reliable rental solutions and outstanding customer service. We are seeking an experienced and organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Managing the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the business. 
•	Coordinating communication between customers, workshop staff, suppliers and management. 
•	Managing financial administration, including rental payments, driver payments, bank reconciliations, outstanding accounts, payment plans and daily financial reporting. 
•	Administering end-to-end motor vehicle insurance claims, including preparing documentation, liaising with insurers and monitoring claims until completion. 
•	Coordinating fleet administration for more than 200 vehicles, including maintenance scheduling, repairs, onboarding and offboarding, GPS installations and vehicle availability. 
•	Preparing repair quotations, sourcing vehicle parts, liaising with suppliers and panel beaters, and supporting workshop operations. 
•	Preparing operational, financial, fleet and insurance reports for management. 
•	Supervising office administration, allocating tasks, assisting with staff onboarding and providing administrative support to employees. 
•	Preparing rental agreements, maintaining electronic records and ensuring accurate business documentation. 
•	Building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, insurers and business partners while resolving enquiries professionally. 
•	Identifying opportunities to improve office procedures and administrative efficiency. 
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
•	At least an AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Administration or a related field; or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	Demonstrated experience in office management or business administration. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
•	Experience in financial administration, including reconciliations and reporting. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and business management software. 
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Desirable
•	Experience in the motor vehicle, transport, fleet management or automotive industry. 
•	Experience dealing with insurance claims and vehicle fleet administration. 
•	Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero. 
Benefits
•	Competitive salary package. 
•	Stable full-time employment. 
•	Supportive and friendly working environment. 
•	Opportunities for career growth and professional development. 
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Asbestos Technician
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Savana Environmental is a Western Australia-based specialist in asbestos removal and environmental remediation. As a licensed Class A asbestos removal contractor, the company delivers end-to-end asbestos management services across residential, commercial, and industrial properties — including testing, removal, and compliant disposal of wall sheeting, ceilings, roofs, eaves, fences, and plant room materials. Savana Environmental also provides contaminated land clearance, ground restoration, and chemical removal services. 

About the role
An Asbestos Technician is responsible for the identification, removal, and disposal of asbestos-containing materials in buildings and structures. They conduct inspections, collect samples for laboratory analysis, and ensure compliance with safety regulations and guidelines to prevent asbestos exposure.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Conduct asbestos surveys and assessments in residential, commercial, and industrial settings.
•	Collect and analyse samples to identify the presence of asbestos.
•	Safely remove and dispose of asbestos-containing materials following established protocols and regulatory guidelines.
•	Operate and maintain specialized equipment for asbestos removal and disposal.
•	Prepare detailed reports and documentation of all asbestos-related activities.
•	Ensure compliance with all safety procedures and regulations, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
•	Communicate effectively with clients, team members, and supervisors regarding project status and findings. 
•	Participate in training sessions and stay updated on industry best practices and regulatory changes.


Essential Skills

•	Uncompromising commitment to workplace health and safety.
•	Precision in constructing enclosures, decontaminating areas, and completing compliance paperwork.
•	Ability to perform manual labour and wear restrictive PPE and RPE for extended periods in varying weather conditions.
•	Ability to work cohesively under the direction of the Site Supervisor and alongside other technicians.
•	Clear verbal and written communication skills for reporting hazards and completing site documentation.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade certificate or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

Employment Type: Full-Time

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Advanced Scaffolders / Scaffolders to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As an Advanced Scaffolder / Scaffolder, you will be responsible for erecting, altering, dismantling, and maintaining scaffolding structures to support construction, maintenance, shutdown, and industrial projects. You will work closely with supervisors and project teams to ensure all scaffolding is installed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with Australian Standards and workplace safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret scaffolding plans, drawings, and specifications.
•	Erect, alter, inspect, and dismantle scaffolding systems for commercial, industrial, and mining projects.
•	Ensure scaffolding structures are safe, secure, and compliant with Australian Standards and site requirements.
•	Install edge protection, temporary access platforms, stair systems, handrails, and safety barriers.
•	Conduct routine inspections of scaffolding and identify defects or maintenance requirements.
•	Load, unload, transport, and organise scaffolding materials and equipment.
•	Safely use hand tools, power tools, lifting equipment, and access equipment.
•	Work effectively at heights while following all safety procedures and risk management requirements.
•	Collaborate with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to ensure project deadlines are achieved.
•	Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance, and completed work where required.
•	Assist in mentoring apprentices and junior scaffolders.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and site regulations.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Scaffolder or Advanced Scaffolder.
•	Ability to read and interpret scaffolding drawings and technical specifications.
•	Experience erecting and dismantling various scaffolding systems in industrial, mining, or construction environments.
•	Strong understanding of safe work practices, working at heights, and Australian scaffolding standards.
•	Ability to work safely in physically demanding environments and at heights.
•	Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
•	High attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
•	Relevant High Risk Work Licence (Scaffolding) and Working at Heights certification will be highly regarded.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

The Vineyard Hotel is a premier hospitality landmark and family-friendly entertainment hub. Spanning an impressive 8-hectare estate on Windsor Road, this iconic venue features a vibrant bistro, an expansive beer garden, live music, and the dedicated "Vineyard Farmhouse" kids' playground, complemented by on-site accommodation at the Gateway Motel.

The Team is currently seeking skilled Cooks and Chefs for full-time positions, offering a competitive salary of $75,000–$85,000 per annum, depending on experience. 
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established venue where quality, creativity, and consistency are truly celebrated.

Scope of the Work:
- Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
- Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
- Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
- Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
- Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
- Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
- Working closely with team members to execute established recipes and menus with consistency and precision, ensuring alignment with seasonal availability and anticipated customer volume.
- Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
- Oversee workstation readiness by ensuring mise en place is complete, equipment is functional, and kitchen operations are primed for service efficiency and food quality standards.
- Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
- Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
- Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.

To be considered for this role, you should:
- Be willing to relocate if you are interstate or in other cities.
- Preferably have Certificates III & IV in Commercial Cookery
- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Have at least 2- 3 years of work experience as a Cook/Chef.
- Ability to work in a team.
- Exceptional communication skills.

What you’ll get in return:
- Opportunities for Career Progression
- Be Part of a Historic, Community-Focused Venue
- Great work environment

How to join the team
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

The Implementation & Activation team is responsible for delivering best-in-class media planning and buying for our award-winning agency brands. 

The scope of the Implementation & Activation team covers all media channels and touchpoints, with a focus on delivering omnichannel media plans in each of our client patches and brands. Sitting centrally alongside our Implementation & Activation team is our Centre of Excellence, housing the Media Operations team and Craft Heads. 

With our collective industry expertise, we navigate the ever-changing media landscape efficiently and effectively, fuelling growth for the brands we work with. Our commitment to transparency and accountability drives best-in-class results consistently, leveraging our exceptional media relationships to keep our finger on the pulse of emerging opportunities.

Role Outline

The Implementation & Activation Director is a leadership role, overseeing operational excellence and responsible for all day-to-day output that delivers effective campaigns, ensuring best-in-class consistent implementation, optimisation, and reporting. Working very closely with your Head Of and Client Partner, you will produce best-in-class solutions, offer unparalleled service and deliver against targets.

The role involves the application and oversight of specialist technical skills, leadership, and strategic vision. 

Key Responsibilities

CLIENTS
A critical senior point of contact with the client, for Implementation Planning & Activation.
Offer expert perspectives and POVs on recent market trends or developments, ensuring they're shared with key stakeholders regularly.
Regularly meet with vendors and partners to drive your client's agenda, creating opportunities for your team members to get involved and engage.
Focus on building our outstanding client service reputation
Robust understanding of the in-scope services of your clients and the process for completing work above and beyond
Provide innovative strategic insights by acting as an expert on the client's business, industry and competitors.

PRODUCT
Brings innovation and creativity to the table, leveraging market insights.
When required, a strict adherence to activation commitments that have client contract association. 
Lead the construction and presentation of effective and future facing Implementation plans and negotiation strategies that are grounded in strategic priorities and data-led optimisation recommendations. 
Exceptional knowledge of the media landscape, able to confidently articulate and train others on media principles and the how each media touchpoint can fuel growth for clients. 
Identify and lead product innovation opportunities for your clients.
Collaborate closely with internal WPP Media teams to ensure you can clearly articulate the benefits of their inclusion, with a focus on converting growth opportunities that can transform outcomes.
Seek to find, communicate and implement improvements in all aspects of the role.
Responsible for the overall delivery of client campaigns & KPIs, with flawless accuracy.
Support the state and national craft leaders in identifying and implementing tools, technology, data, and automation solutions through the organisation, and then ensuring maximum adoption of best practice.

PEOPLE
Motivate and empower team to achieve individual, team and organisational goals. 
Conduct fortnightly 1:1s, annual Career Conversations and Performance Reviews with direct reports.
Liaise with the People Team to resolve any team disputes to ensure a safe and productive team environment. 
Continuously champion company values to build strong and trusted connections, solution-oriented perspectives and demonstrate genuine care for collective team success.
Foster knowledge sharing, and continuous learning around point of views, trends, and relevant skills to continue nurturing a high-performing team.

GROWTH & MARKETING
Identify, collate and showcase examples of great work from within the team, both internally and externally.
Build the agency’s reputation by contributing to entries for awards and competitions and by contributing to industry thought leadership.
Actively contribute to new business development and pitching as needed.

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES
You feel empowered to bring your authentic self to work, and contribute to great teamwork, knowing your individual ideas and thoughts will be welcome.
Keen interest in our industry and excited to work with market leading partners & technologies.
Inquisitive and demonstrates desire to understand and know more. 
Ability to prioritise tasks effectively, ensuring that the most important and urgent ones are identified and addressed first. 
Results driven with the ability to identify and clearly articulate what’s working and why. 
Problem solving mentality. Attention to detail. Clear communicator.
result.title: Implementation & Activation Director

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for full-time Sous Chef and Head Chef professionals for our client in Armadale, Victoria. These roles are responsible for delivering exceptional culinary experiences by preparing high-quality food, maintaining outstanding kitchen operations, ensuring compliance with food safety standards, and leading efficient kitchen teams. The Head Chef oversees all aspects of kitchen management, menu development, and operational performance, while the Sous Chef supports the Head Chef in the day-to-day management of the kitchen and ensures the smooth delivery of food service.

?

Sous Chef

Job Description

• Assist the Head Chef in menu planning, recipe creation, and food preparation.

• Oversee and supervise kitchen staff to ensure smooth kitchen operations.

• Manage the preparation and cooking of food in all sections of the kitchen.

• Prepare and cook a diverse range of dishes, upholding stringent quality, portion size, presentation, and food safety standards.

• Maintain high standards of food hygiene and safety.

• Monitor inventory and order stock as necessary.

• Manage kitchen operations in the absence of the Head Chef.

• Train and mentor junior kitchen staff.

• Ensure that dishes are prepared and presented according to the restaurant’s standards.

• Communicate effectively with the front-of-house team to ensure efficient service.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Sous Chef, Chef de Partie, or in a similar commercial kitchen role.

• Strong knowledge of commercial food preparation, cooking techniques, and menu planning.

• Demonstrated ability to supervise, train, and mentor junior kitchen staff.

• Thorough understanding of food safety, HACCP, workplace health and safety, and kitchen hygiene standards.

• Experience managing food preparation across multiple kitchen sections.

• Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

• High attention to detail with a commitment to quality, consistency, and presentation.

• Passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional dining experiences.

?

Head Chef

Job Description

• Prepare, cook and present food, consistently exceeding high culinary standards.

• Lead, direct and oversee daily kitchen operations, fostering teamwork and efficiency.

• Collaborate closely with the director to strategise and craft innovative recipes and menus, considering seasonal ingredient availability, portion sizing, and customer preferences.

• Monitor and inspect completed dishes to ensure food is prepared, presented and served in accordance with established recipes, quality standards and presentation requirements.

• Provide cost estimates for new menu items while adhering to budgetary targets.

• Maintain and monitor stock levels to minimise wastage and implement effective inventory control practices for efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

• Handle supply procurement by ordering food and essential supplies to meet kitchen demands and actively negotiating with sales representatives to secure competitive pricing and streamline operations.

• Oversee compliance with established health and safety standards through routine inspection of equipment, work areas, and supplies to ensure a safe and sanitary kitchen environment.

• Instruct and train kitchen personnel in various aspects of food preparation, cooking techniques, garnishing, and presentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve kitchen systems and service efficiency, implementing improvements as needed.

• Plan kitchen requirements including staffing levels, preparation schedules and workflow processes to ensure smooth service delivery.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Head Chef or in a senior commercial kitchen leadership role.

• Demonstrated experience leading and managing commercial kitchen operations.

• Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.

• Extensive knowledge of menu planning, recipe development, food costing, and kitchen budgeting.

• Experience managing inventory, supplier relationships, procurement, and stock control.

• Thorough understanding of food safety, HACCP, workplace health and safety, and kitchen compliance requirements.

• Strong organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead and motivate high-performing kitchen teams.

• Passion for culinary excellence, innovation, and delivering consistently outstanding dining experiences.

?

Salary Range

$75,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
